lines.text: Bel and Nebo's idols weigh down beasts and cattle, and the gods themselves go into captivity.
The LORD says He has carried Jacob's house since birth and will bear them up when they turn gray.
People pour out bags of gold, hire a goldsmith to make a god, and set it in its place.
The LORD declares the end from the beginning and summons a lion from the east for His purpose.
The LORD is bringing His righteousness near and will grant salvation to Bethel and adorn Israel with His splendor.
